area: east of Bakersfield near the county dump
summary: Grass fire that grew to 5–10 acres, dubbed the Apollo Incident — burning roughly 2 miles east of the dump and north of the railroad tracks. Response included engine 345, water tender 12, dozers, a safety officer and helicopter 409, with crews working access through corral roads and gates. Union Pacific train traffic was held while crews mopped up.

area: alley across from the 100 block of Belle Avenue
summary: Fire in an alley that spread to a house, upgraded to a structure response with Engine 63, Truck 1, Medics Squad 63 and Battalion 6.
Vehicle crashed into a building in the 9800 block of South Union Avenue; CHP en route with a fire battalion response.

area: Copus Road, about 5.5 miles west of Old River
summary: Head-on collision between two vehicles with a reporting party on scene; an additional engine and Truck 54 were pulled in, and an air ambulance stood by before being cancelled.

Burglary in progress — suspect described as a white male, 5-foot-11, about 150 pounds, in a white tank top and black gym shorts, last seen riding a blue beach cruiser and exiting onto Union Avenue. Units searching.
Pursuit ended near 3rd & Union when the driver bailed and jumped a fence into a business yard; the female passenger was uncooperative. Officers searching the area.
Person in crisis, reportedly nude at 21st & O with a shirt draped over them; possible psychiatric episode. Units responding.
Report of a large car meet gathering in a parking lot; units checking.
A woman reported a man banging on her door as she screamed at him to leave; banging audible in the background. Heavy-duty response requested.
Two subjects seen in the yard at a recycling business digging through materials with flashlights. No further description.
Driver reportedly slumped over at the wheel of a black Chevy SUV, swerving with loud music; units moving to stop the vehicle.
Reporting party heard multiple shots; units responded code.
Caller watching a vacant residence for the owner reported unknown subjects in a blue Honda dropping items off, then leaving southbound.
Report of a 6-year-old possibly locked out of a residence by someone inside. Units responding.
Disturbance reported at a business in the 2700 block of White Lane.
Vehicle reportedly not stopping on Highway 99 toward the 223 — possible pursuit in progress.
